title: China Price Check: Zhangjiajie $33 vs Yosemite $35 | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone thinks China's parks are cheap. Zhangjiajie costs about the same as Yosemite — and in 2026 the math flips.

Zhangjiajie's Wulingyuan core area is ~¥236 (about $33) for a 4-day pass with unlimited eco-buses. Yosemite is $35 — but that's per vehicle, a whole carful, while Zhangjiajie's price is per person. Then on Jan 1, 2026 Yosemite added a $100 fee per international visitor. So which one is really the bargain depends entirely on how you count.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book Zhangjiajie online 2-3 days ahead — the core area runs on real-name reservations and rarely sells tickets at the gate.

中国的山不一定便宜：张家界 ¥236（约$33/人，4天），优胜美地 $35/车——2026 起外国游客再加 $100/人。
